planning.pilot_source: task13 32 old games, ONLY for sizing; all old seeds and outcomes excluded from new inference

sampling.trajectory: v30 alone, full episodes<=3000 decisions, no teacher actions executed
sampling.point_selection: exact task12: all legal-plant roots where policy plants or tick-last hypothetical search>=300; choose8 uniformly without replacement using Random(20261020+seed); sorted decision
sampling.short_game: if fewer than8 eligible roots, declare protocol violation and stop; no adaptive replacement seeds

arms.A: unchanged desktop branch1 per-card1 + wait + mandatory student + 2 additional distinct student plants
arms.B3: student-topk3 plants + wait + mandatory policy, no per-card floor, no static candidate scoring

search.future_seeds: D=seed*10000+decision-1, k exactly original; both arms same D
search.order: alternate A-first/B3-first by (seed+decision)%2 to reduce systematic CPU timing order effects

reference.pool: task12 canonical union: original desktop and Mac candidates, each static top2/card, one extra random legal cell/card using Random(20261020+D); additionally include ALL A and B3 candidates; sort by common.key
reference.Mac: only construct its original candidate list, no Mac light teacher or other ablation arms
reference.teacher: every pool action64 common futures at truthD=D+33333333, v3 leaf, original terminal-first accumulation, full pool no halving; original anchored margin.02 + V18 verification
reference.exact_cancellation: if A and B3 actions identical, delta_correctness=0 for EVERY possible common heavy label; skip heavy evaluation and retain the root with delta0 in the full2048-point estimand. For different actions evaluate the complete common heavy teacher, even if both ultimately wrong. No pooling old roots or inferred labels.
reference.absolute_rates: do not claim full-sample absolute A/B accuracy for roots without heavy labels; report exact paired difference and conditional judged-root accuracy, plus bounds if useful

statistics.estimand: mean over new roots of 1[B3 chosen==common heavy]-1[A chosen==common heavy]
statistics.primary: 256 whole-game means, each8 roots; two-sided95% Student-t CI (df255); declare B3 NI only if lower > -.03. Single final efficacy look, no four-arm multiplicity.
statistics.sensitivity: 10000 paired whole-game bootstrap replicates with seed20261020,95% interval. Report both; a contradiction precludes a robust-NI recommendation.
statistics.cost: actual simulator calls per arm including verification; paired per-game saving ratio and95% bootstrap interval
statistics.cpu: per search arm sum Python worker user+system (getrusage self) and its live simulator user+system (/proc/pid/stat), measured immediately around actual search; include static branch/scoring for A, student ranking for B3 and all leaf scoring; exclude shared v30 root action, replay, startup and reference computation; record components and total. CPU clock ticks quantized but summed over2048 roots.
statistics.no_win_claim: reference is v3/64 futures, not actual win rate; NI3pp is a tolerated deficit, not exact equivalence

interim.policy: resource feasibility only; do not inspect efficacy or change sample size based on outcomes; no early NI claim
interim.budget_stop: if first128 complete after >90min active experiment wall (excluding memory pauses), stop for prespecified180min projected compute budget; report achieved128/1024 with descriptive CI and NO formal NI claim. Otherwise mandatory256. If external quota ends, checkpoint and resume same jobs; never restart a live handle.

resources: max4 own game processes; MemAvailable<2GiB pause only owned subtree, resume>=3GiB; CPU only; frozen build-task12; untouched protected worktrees and formal training
deliverables: append task14 to MEMORY/docs/static-value-ablation.md, plan/results/execution JSON; push cuda-merge only; homepage actual ready fast-forward commit; defaults unchanged
